sources.notes: Road elevations are edited from ICGC MET 50cm 2021-2023 ground raster (Institut Cartogràfic i Geològic de Catalunya (ICGC), CC BY 4.0). Edited from the ICGC 2021-2023 50 cm ground LiDAR terrain model under CC BY 4.0. Bilinear samples at paired road midpoints, compressed within 0.25 m of sampled heights. Both the deck and occluded lower road interpolate only between their separate ground approach endpoints; interior ground cells are excluded from both spans. Heights and clearance remain estimates, not a bridge survey. Original raster crop retained by native source-grid window and SHA256; no nominal deck height assigned. The bridge uses explicit paired source stations; cross-sections never select another road branch. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations, not verified curb locations. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Borders retain their feature licences and unverified status. Imagery loads externally; no meshes, image bytes or videos are stored.

supersedes.reason: Original unequal edge station grids do not reproduce the source-backed overpass. Replace only after complete licensed-image paired-edge review; preserve original pair and model in shared research proof.

measurement.note: Road-edge estimates from 79 labelled native-image cross-sections, roughly 1-2 m image-reading precision, not surveyed positional accuracy. The lower crossing joins visible approaches beneath an occluded deck. Dense fitted controls interpolate normal offsets along the preserved source path; they are not independent image observations. Bend transitions and the pit-side separating paint were checked on the full overlay; these remain estimated limits, not a survey. No nominal width, length fitting or nominal bridge height. Curbs illustrative and banking unknown.

crossings.note: Selected source bridge31905798v2 layer2. Upper approach interval extends beyond both mapped bridge endpoints; lower road uses separate visible approaches. Source trace and timing remain unchanged. Both road levels ground-derived estimates, not surveyed clearance.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed from complete pairs of sparse image-edge measurements. Each pair defines its own road section; the original trace is preserved and constrains station displacement and route order. Linear intervals, junction openings and curbs remain estimates, not surveyed racing limits. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. No automatic evidence scores are claimed.
